scene: The clock chimes, signalling transit departure gates along the breezy terrace below.
picture: Side view along the stone terrace. On the far left sits a yellow bicycle rickshaw. In the centre stands the elderly East Asian man in his blue cap and orange cardigan holding his cane. On the right, steps lead down to a blue water taxi. On the far right, a shiny monorail waits.
shown: A yellow wheeled bicycle rickshaw with canopy waiting on the far left
A blue-striped boat bobbing beside steps down to water on the right
A sleek glass-domed monorail train doors open at a platform far right
